decisions.rule: Do not use the main branch's 45.9% legacy accuracy figure as skill. It is NOT_COMPARABLE until immutable fixed-horizon outcomes, point-in-time cutoffs, leakage controls and calibration exist.
A signal with stale timestamp, confidence 0.0 and provider errors is NOT_A_FORECAST and must not enter evaluation.
Scheduled research workflows should be read-only and artifact-only; repository writes and merges require explicit authorized approval.
Never infer product identity from average price or quantity. Preserve unidentified state and fail closed before provider calls or mutation.
Do not expose write tokens to remote-code execution. Isolate upload credentials on a fresh runner; additionally require artifact integrity/provenance and human upload approval.
Record push-event zero-job approval workflow failures as unresolved; do not infer root cause or dispatch the workflow to test it.
